verdict: Clearbit: Choose Clearbit / Breeze Intelligence when HubSpot-native enrichment is the job and you already (or will) buy HubSpot credits. Scores use the sales-intelligence editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing.

recommendation: Choose Clearbit / Breeze Intelligence when HubSpot-native enrichment is the job and you already (or will) buy HubSpot credits. Compare Clay for multi-provider waterfalls, Lusha for SMB enrichment+contact data, ZoomInfo for enterprise databases, and Apollo for prospecting+sequences.
